stories.title: Arcadia classrooms test UW-Madison AI tool to support teaching
stories.synopsis: Sixth-graders at Arcadia Middle School are helping test an AI tool from UW-Madison that transcribes and translates their group discussions. It helps teacher Allyson LaFave see whether students are using key concepts, staying on task and all contributing. That matters in a district where 75% of students are English-language learners, and the tool is meant to help teachers, not replace them.

stories.title: Chhattisgarh tests AI cameras for wildlife, poaching alerts
stories.synopsis: In Udanti-Sitanadi Tiger Reserve, a pilot system puts AI cameras on 70-80-ft towers to keep track of elephants and tigers and to spot poachers. Instant WhatsApp alerts go to forest officials. A peer-to-peer wireless network lets it work in real time even where there's no mobile coverage, across five forest ranges near the Odisha border.

stories.title: Leading the next era of AI-enabled drug discovery
stories.synopsis: At UNC's Eshelman School of Pharmacy, researchers are blending chemistry, biology and computing so AI can help find tomorrow's medicines faster. One lab is using AI to tackle health challenges including tuberculosis, cancer and Alzheimer's disease. The team is also working to make these tools affordable for more labs, while stressing that AI works best alongside scientists' expertise.
